meta.name: Point FeeConfig.platformVault at the new BuybackBurnerV2 (TEMPLATE)

transactions._comment: The load-bearing transaction: FeeConfig.setPlatformVault(<BuybackBurnerV2 address>). FeeConfig (gen-4, current) is Ownable2Step, owner() confirmed as this Safe on 2026-09-29 (re-verify with `cast call 0xE09F093595045E8765F420Cb12E0AA250910E5AD "owner()(address)"` before signing -- RPC was unreachable from the agent sandbox this session so this could not be re-checked live). Once this lands, EVERY future swap's platform fee share (20% of the hook's 1% fee, across EVERY pool this chain's singleton BallastHook serves, not just BALLAST v2's own pool) accrues as owed(BuybackBurnerV2) instead of owed(Safe), and BuybackBurnerV2's own buybackAndBurn/claimFees pulls it permissionlessly -- no further Safe action needed for ongoing funding. Compute the real calldata with: cast calldata "setPlatformVault(address)" <BuybackBurnerV2address>. Fill in the real deployed address before signing -- this file is a template, not ready to sign as-is. Sign this AFTER confirming the backfill step (docs/BUYBACK_BURN_GO_LIVE.md step 5) has already swept whatever was owed to the Safe under the OLD platformVault setting, since this change does not retroactively move past accrual.
